title: Khmer Sentiment (3-class)
description: Label Studio configuration for POS/NEG/NEU sentiment on Khmer texts
config:
<View>
  <Text name="text" value="$text"/>
  <Choices name="label" toName="text" choice="single" showInline="true">
    <Choice value="POS" background="#4CAF50"/>
    <Choice value="NEG" background="#F44336"/>
    <Choice value="NEU" background="#9E9E9E"/>
  </Choices>
</View>
